name: Noachian-Orrery
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by magnetic pole anomalies. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in uranium and water and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
